PART A
1. The present batch of appeals involves the interplay of three Parliamentary statutes: the Income Tax Act 1961, the Taxation and Other Laws (Relaxation and Amendment of Certain Provisions) Act 2020, and the Finance Act 2021.

The Income Tax Act was enacted to levy and collect tax on the income of assessees. Sections 147 to 151 of the Income Tax Act deal with reassessment of income that has escaped assessment.
